schemaVersion.description: Generator schema version, always the component id.

title.description: Short title for students in plain text.

orderBasis.description: How the order was determined on the page.

cyclic.description: True only when the page states a cycle.

orderNote.description: Note about the order in plain text, empty string or 5 to 120 characters.

id.description: Lowercase kebab step id, 40 characters or fewer.

label.description: Short event name for the step in plain text, 1 to 80 characters (about 8 words); the quote is the verbatim evidence for it.

sourceId.description: Id of the source the quote was copied from.

quote.description: Exact characters copied from the source, no ellipsis, 150 characters or fewer.

orderHint.description: Short ordering hint in plain text.
